name: go-darom
description: Go Darom — Hebrew RTL Go community platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @go-darom/shared && npm run build -w @go-darom/go-engine && npm run build -w @go-darom/api && npm run build -w @go-darom/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @go-darom/shared && npm run typecheck -w @go-darom/go-engine && npm run typecheck -w @go-darom/api && npm run typecheck -w @go-darom/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @go-darom/shared && npm run lint -w @go-darom/go-engine && npm run lint -w @go-darom/api && npm run lint -w @go-darom/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @go-darom/go-engine && npm run test -w @go-darom/api
